title: Meeting Rooms
description: Decide whether one person can attend every meeting interval. Input order is arbitrary. Endpoints touching at the same time do not conflict: an ending meeting frees the person for a meeting starting then.

examples.explain: The first meeting overlaps the other two.
examples.raw:
Input: intervals = [[0,30],[5,10],[15,20]]
Output: false
Explanation: The first meeting overlaps the other two.

Input: intervals = [[5,8],[9,15]]
Output: true
Explanation: Touching endpoints do not conflict.

hints: Sort by start time, then one linear scan suffices.
Track the latest end seen so far; a start before it means a clash.
An empty schedule is trivially attendable.
solution: Sort by start and scan once, keeping the furthest end seen; any start before it collides. O(n log n) time for the sort.

provenance.note: Statement authored from the brief for the native port; not copied. Generated tests are labeled. NeetCode uses Interval objects; canAttendMeetings. Interval construction per judge extension.
